description: Fetch the full, untruncated clean Markdown text of a specific engineering article by lang, pillar, and slug. Use this after discovering valid pillar and slug values via search_articles; do not use it for keyword search (use search_articles) or candidate CV details (use get_candidate_profile). Read-only, unauthenticated, no side effects, and subject to a 30 req/min per-IP rate limit. Returns isError: true with invalid_lang, invalid_slug, or article_fetch_404 if the parameters are malformed or the article does not exist.

lang.description: Required article language ("en" for English, "de" for German); must match the article URL.

name: read_article
